programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Through his law partner, John Todd Stuart, Lincoln meets and marries Mary Todd in 1842; he wins the election to Congress in 1846, but his term is undistinguished; Lincoln returns to a life of domestic unhappiness; substantial success as an attorney.

programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Lincoln's folksiness is a shield he rarely lets down; many see him as an introverted, slightly aloof lawyer; he dislikes wanna-be aristocrats and is a tremendous reader; he believes in God, but not the God of any formal religion.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: The methods archeologists use in looking for sites; the uses of remote sensing technologies, which enable archeologists to visualize objects obscured by vegetation and soil; investigating ground surveys, which reveal information before digging.
programme.sub-title: How Do Archaeologists Know Where to Dig?

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Prehistoric archeology allows one to glimpse the earliest times in hominid and human history; learning about seminal 20th-century finds of hominids in Africa; discovering the figural cave paintings of Lascaux, Altamira and Chauvet.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Significant Neolithic sites; exploring Gobekli Tepe, whose stone rings are the oldest known examples of monumental architecture in the early Near East; the tombs and tower of Jericho; Catalhoyuk is noted for its houses without doors or windows.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: A first look at the wonders of Egyptology; the deciphering of hieroglyphics; the techniques of ancient Egyptian embalming and mummification; the stories behind the building of the Step Pyramid of Zozer, the Pyramids at Giza and the Sphinx.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The conquests of Alexander the Great give birth to the Hellenistic world; Alexander's military expansionism brings a vast geographical area under the Greek civilization; Alexander's empire fragments after his death; Alexandria, a center of learning.
programme.sub-title: Alexander the Great: Greek Culture Spreads

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The conflicted relationship between the Greeks and their Roman conquerors; Greek culture's impact on Rome; the founding of the Byzantine Empire, its flourishing of scholarship and theology; the role of Islamic scholars in preserving Greek learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Constantinople's fall in 1453; the Greeks under the Ottomans; Europe rediscovers classical antiquity; the philosophical spirit of the Renaissance, which brings a sudden interest in the ancient Greeks; the influence of Greek mythology on Western art.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The struggle of the Greeks under the Ottomans; European intellectuals and Europe's major powers support the movement to free Greece; the nation-state of Greece in 1830; Greece's territorial expansion; its tumultuous modern history up to the present.
programme.sub-title: The Birth of the Greek Nation-State

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The influence of philosophy on the morality and conduct of Rome's ruling classes; an influence rarely matched in the Western tradition; Christian theologians employing the doctrines of these two philosophical schools in defining their own faith.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Knowing what role Judaism plays in the Roman Empire; learning how Rome's experience with this stalwart monotheistic faith, the first it has encountered, differs from the challenge of the Christian faith that emerges from it.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The first years of efforts to convert people to Christianity; the early leadership by James of those who are often called Jewish Christians; the career of Paul, from his own conversion after a vision to his work propagating the message of Jesus.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Early responses to Christianity; the violent persecutions in Rome under Nero; the legalistic and easily avoided persecutions under later emperors; Roman ignorance of Christianity; the eventual momentum that ignorance gives the new faith.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: As the Hittites unite Anatolia, early Greeks called Achaeans visit its western reaches; Achaean warlords trade and raid along the shores of Asia Minor; in time, they become the first Greeks to clash with the armies of a great king to the east.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: The most enduring legacies from early Anatolia are "The Iliad" and "The Odyssey": how the siege of Troy and the exploits of Homer's warrior chieftains fit into the wider tale of imperial struggle and decline during the Greek Dark Age.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 1200 B.C. to 1000 B.C., migrations reshape Anatolia; Phrygians come from the Balkans, only to be overcome by Cimmerian nomads; in the West, Hittite provincials found trade-rich Lydia, whose last king is Croesus.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 750 B.C., the Greeks distinguish themselves with the polis, a city-state based on citizen rule; by 500 B.C., Athens devises the first democratic constitution, with all adult male citizens forming the sovereign assembly.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals and how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.
programme.sub-title: Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.
programme.sub-title: Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.
programme.sub-title: Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.
programme.sub-title: Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.
programme.sub-title: A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.
programme.sub-title: Why Study Battles? What Is War?

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.
programme.sub-title: Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Evidence of warfare in Ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.
programme.sub-title: Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.
programme.sub-title: The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
programme.desc: Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

programme.title: Streets of Fire
programme.desc: Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: "Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother...who is blind.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: To save the homes of his family and friends, John "Rappin" Hood (Mario Van Peebles) rallies with his fast-talking comrades to fight back. Not with their fists... but with their powerful rap!

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: What's The Worst That Could Happen?
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence and Danny DeVito escalate a battle of egos to epic proportions in this hilarious comedy.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Struggling actor Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) dreams of landing a role, but soon learns you have to "dream" up your own roles. Keenen Ivory Wayans and Anne-Marie Johnson also star.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in the world's most notorious prison colony, two tougher-than-nails inmates enact the ultimate jail break.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1958)
programme.desc: Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: A prison psychiatrist (the legendary Sidney Poitier) is charged with treating a hate-filled young man (Bobby Darin).

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: Lt. Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier), asks to be assigned to the case of a reverend accused of murder in San Francisco in hopes of clearing his friend's name.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier is back as Lt. Virgil Tibbs! When six masked figures rob a seemingly normal furniture factory, they leave with a multimillion-dollar cache of heroin!

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Leon Isaac Kennedy stars as Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone, a man convicted for a murder he didn't commit, who must use his wits and fists to survive his harrowing existence in the penitentiary.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: When his old adversary escapes from the pen with vengeance on his mind, the newly freed Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone has no choice but to fight back!

programme.title: Body And Soul (1981)
programme.desc: To help his family, an amateur enters the lucrative world of pro boxing. But he's soon swept up in his success and its temptations. Featuring the legendary Muhammed Ali.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: In this powerful drama, respected teacher Quincy Davis accepts an offer to become Vice Principal of an inner-city school poised to be integrated.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram and Eddie are two jazz musicians living in Paris and falling in love with two young American girls.

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Mientras todos celebran en la boda de Alicia y Tomás, Marcia llora por Fernando; Carolina empieza a reconocer sus sentimientos por Omar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Debido a la falta de actores, Fernando decide protagonizar el episodio piloto del programa de televisión de Conceptos; Aldo empieza a trabajar con Carmina en un libro de cocina.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Gracias a Fernando, la presentación del episodio piloto es un éxito; Lety comienza a sentirse culpable por su doble identidad y quiere confesarle la verdad a Aldo y su asistente.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia y Tomás regresan de su luna de miel y Tomás le muestra a Alicia su nueva casa; Aurora acepta hacer el programa de televisión de Fernando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le propone matrimonio a Lety; Fernando decide coquetear con Aurora para darle celos a Lety; Alicia y Tomás inician su vida de casados.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo y Fernando aclaran su situación respecto a Lety; Carolina le cuenta a Luigi y Marcia cómo se siente por Omar; Alicia despilfarra el dinero de Tomás.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar descubre sus sentimientos hacia Carolina; las mujeres del cuartel se preparan para su cita con Fernando Colunga; Fernando le prepara una sorpresa a Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le dice a doña Julieta que se casará con Aldo; Omar está tan feliz con Carolina, que se muestra indiferente con Aurora; comienzan las grabaciones para el programa de televisión.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Comienzan las complicaciones en la filmación del programa de televisión; Omar le rompe el corazón a Carolina; Fernando descubre la verdadera identidad de Aurora.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety está decidida a desaparecer a Aurora de su vida; Omar intenta recuperar a Carolina; Irmita y Sara llevan a Martha a una reunión de comedores compulsivos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo, Fernando y los medios de comunicación presionan a Lety por la desaparición de Aurora; Alicia le dice a Tomás que está embarazada.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Martha está decidida a remediar su desorden alimenticio; doña Julieta regaña a Lety por apresurar su boda con Aldo, ya que sigue queriendo a Fernando, además le pide que aclare el malentendido de Aurora.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Tomás le cuenta a Lety que doña Julieta está intentando sabotear su boda con Aldo; Omar acude con Tomás para poder conquistar a Carolina.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Gracias a doña Julieta, Fernando se entera de la verdadera identidad de Aurora; Alicia y Tomás pasan su primera noche juntos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Simón recibe su nuevo puesto en Conceptos y le propone matrimonio a Paula María; Fernando y Omar llevan al nuevo coordinador de informática a celebrar su próxima boda.

programme.title: La fea más bella

programme.desc: Luigi transforma a Lety en su verdadero yo y todos quedan fascinados en la oficina; Fernando intenta arreglar la relación entre Aldo y Leticia; Alicia decide robarle dinero a Tomás.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia intenta despedirse de Tomás y se arrepiente de haberlo lastimado; Aldo entrega Conceptos a sus verdaderos dueños.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety prepara todo para su boda con Fernando; Tomás y Alicia deciden reanudar su relación; la tan esperada boda de los protagonistas.

programme.desc: Lety se presenta a una entrevista de trabajo en Conceptos, una casa productora, para ser secretaria ejecutiva, pero compite con la bella pero inexperta Alicia.

programme.desc: Fernando les asigna a Lety y Alicia sus funciones en la empresa: Lety se encargará del papeleo y Alicia de las relaciones públicas.

programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por doña Lucha y Carmelo. Albertano seduce a María, quien despierta y sorprende a todos.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: María sale del hospital y todos en la vecindad la reciben con cariño, María le pide a Doña Lucha le prepare pozole para celebrar que despertó del coma e invita a toda la vecindad. Llega la enfermera a casa de Albertano y pelea con María por su amor.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica le da un gran susto a Bibi, ella se desmaya y al despertar se vuelve agresiva y maleducada. Federica se pone muy feliz porque su hija ya es normal, la consiente y le perdona todo.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Un famoso productor de comerciales quiere contratar a Ludoviquito, Federica y Ludovico se pelean por ser el representante de su hijo para quedarse con el dinero que gane.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: ¡Los Cossio tienen visita! Llega la familia de Toña y como ella les contó algo diferente a la realidad, Paco tiene que fingir ser su novio. A Fran le toca el papel de mayordomo.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Paco llega al departamento con Meche, una amiga, y ella les propone ir a un desnudo masivo en las pirámides de Teotihuacán para unas fotos. Les promete que es una experiencia única, mágica. Toña es la única que no se anima.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Luis le reclama a Frankie porque su lavadora no lo deja dormir con lo que inicia una guerra entre ellos a ver quién hace más ruido. Marco le pide ayuda a Alejandra para conquistar a su amiga.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Los vecinos se enojan con Germán por no avisarles que iban a suspender el suministro de agua. Meten a Benito al tanque para ver cuánta agua les queda, y se les olvida sacarlo de ahí.

programme.title: Los héroes del norte
programme.desc: Zacarías regresa feliz con su nuevo tema "Lo Intentamos" y retoma el liderazgo de la banda, enfrentando a Trácalas para deshacerse de él.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: El Vítor y Albertano le cuentan a Rosita y doña Cuca que trabajarán de guardaespaldas de Ninel Conde, pero ellas no creen que duren en ese trabajo y hacen una apuesta. Ninel les dice al Vítor y Albertano las reglas para poder trabajar con ella.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: En su constante búsqueda por ganar dinero y pagarle a Doña Cuca la renta, Vítor y Albertano se emplean en una funeraria. Entre errores y enredos, se darán cuenta de que lo peor que le puede pasar a una persona no es la muerte.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por doña Lucha y Carmelo. Albertano seduce a María, quien despierta y sorprende a todos.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: María sale del hospital y todos en la vecindad la reciben con cariño, María le pide a Doña Lucha le prepare pozole para celebrar que despertó del coma e invita a toda la vecindad. Llega la enfermera a casa de Albertano y pelea con María por su amor.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Federica le da un gran susto a Bibi, ella se desmaya y al despertar se vuelve agresiva y maleducada. Federica se pone muy feliz porque su hija ya es normal, la consiente y le perdona todo.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Un famoso productor de comerciales quiere contratar a Ludoviquito, Federica y Ludovico se pelean por ser el representante de su hijo para quedarse con el dinero que gane.

programme.title: 40 y 20

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: El chino entra a la escuela y lleva a su casa al Macaco, al verlo Doña Lucha le prohíbe juntarse con él, pero termina aceptándolo. Albertano se entristece, no tiene amigos, pero el chino y Macaco le ofrecen su amistad.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Se aparece la madre de María quién la abandonó por andar de cantina en cantina y en las ferias. En la azotea juega Doña Lucha con toda su familia, al subir la mamá de María se pone a jugar con ellos, apuesta las cosas de María y pierde todo.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Don Camerino le da un ascenso a Ludovico y necesita estar bien descansado para cumplir sus nuevas obligaciones. Ludovico le pide a Federica que lo deje dormir. Al día siguiente, Ludovico se duerme en la oficina y no puede cumplir bien con su trabajo.

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Eximio, el exnovio de Excelsa regresa a buscarla y quiere llevársela con él, pero Federica no quiere que se vaya y prefiere pedirle a Eximio que se quede a vivir en su casa.

programme.desc: El sobrino de Paco, Jacobito, llega a pasar unos días con ellos porque está de vacaciones. Sin embargo, no deja a Paco estar a solas con su novia Mayra, y hasta duerme con ellos.

programme.title: Nosotros los guapos
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano ayudan a doña Cuca a abrir un pequeño restaurante en el patio de la casa, Lupita tendrá la suerte de ayudar a esta singular pareja.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Adolfo pierde el bono huachicolero por bañarse, y con la ayuda de Jacinta se convierte en hierbero. Carlos recibe regalos de un admirador secreto.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: A Renata le encanta espiar a sus vecinos desde la ventana del dormitorio con el telescopio de Justito para confirmar o desmentir chismes. Justito le da clases de regularización a Victoria.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Por unos estornudos de Plácido, la Nena será la enfermera encargada de cuidarlo. Mientras, Gaby se convierte en maquilladora y peinadora.

programme.title: María de Todos los Ángeles
programme.desc: Es el baile anual de los pequeños comerciantes, María va acompañada de Albertano. En la fiesta Rosa Aurora conoce al dueño de varias cremerías, él compra todos los boletos y la ganadora de reina es Rosa. Llega un amor de la presidenta del sindicato.
programme.sub-title: El Extraño Mundo de los Comerciantes

programme.sub-title: El que no se arriesga no cruza el río

programme.sub-title: A amor mal correspondido, ausencia y olvido

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un chico comete algunos errores en el pasado y ahora trata de hacer bien las cosas, aunque necesita apoyo para no reincidir. Discriminar a alguien por sus fallas pasadas, puede provocar que muchas personas no puedan rehacer su vida.
programme.sub-title: Cuando la burra es mañosa, aunque la carguen de santos

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Estrella queda parapléjica por un accidente y su papá no permite que salga al mundo; gracias a Vero, su terapeuta, y a Mateo, se atreverán a tomar riesgos para hacer cosas nuevas y luchará contra los prejuicios y la intolerancia.
programme.sub-title: El que no se arriesga no cruza el río

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Ana se relaciona con un hombre casado, quien le promete estar con ella siempre, pero pronto se da cuenta de los engaños de Bernardo y aprende con Daniel a no depender de nadie y a luchar por ella misma.
programme.sub-title: A amor mal correspondido, ausencia y olvido

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Aconsejada por su amiga Karla de que las vacunas en los niños son contraproducentes para su salud, Alicia no verifica la información con expertos e impide que su hijo recién nacido sea vacunado, poniendo en riesgo la salud de su bebé.
programme.sub-title: La salud no tiene precio y el que la arriesga es un necio

programme.title: Como dice el dicho

programme.sub-title: Mala y engañosa ciencia es juzgar por las apariencias

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
